_comment: Curated work photos. This file is the single source of truth for both
scripts/import-photos.mjs (which reads `source` to find the original and
writes `src`) and the site (which reads everything else to render).
`source` names a file inside the work-pictures archive. Originals are NOT
in this repo — see scripts/import-photos.mjs for how to re-run the import.
Captions state what is in the frame and nothing more. Where a photo backs a
specific claim the caption may say so, but it must not assert anything the

clusters.label: Smart ATM controller
clusters.blurb: Controller hardware, assembled units and the operator interface for QuePay's payment-enabled machines.

clusters.label: Bench and bring-up
clusters.blurb: Board bring-up, rail validation and assembly — the unglamorous half of hardware.

clusters.label: Field instrumentation
clusters.blurb: Industrial I/O, control panel build and field hardware from Veno Autobotics.

clusters.label: Power electronics
clusters.blurb: Power distribution hardware, modelled and rendered.

clusters.label: On the production floor
clusters.blurb: At EADAK in Athi River, one of the few electronics manufacturing plants in the region — seeing how a design behaves once it leaves the bench and meets a production line.

clusters.label: Personal projects
clusters.blurb: Boards designed outside work, published open source.

clusters.label: About
clusters.blurb: Used on the About page, not shown in the gallery grid.
